patterns.note: Asymmetrical, editorial-style layouts with generous negative space, often featuring large text blocks juxtaposed with empty areas or single images.
A clear typographic hierarchy uses an elegant serif font for prominent headings and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A dominant light beige background (#fcfaf5-like) provides a warm, earthy canvas, contrasted by dark grey/black text and natural tones in photography.

The initial hero section with scattered images and a central age gate acts as a distinct, tall viewport. Upon scrolling past this initial height, the age gate and its surrounding images disappear, and the main content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.

Content is organized into distinct, well-separated sections, each introduced by a large serif heading and often featuring a two-column layout with text on one side and ample negative space or a relevant image on the other.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header for the brand logo, ensuring it remains visible throughout the scroll.

The initial hero experience is designed as a full-viewport overlay or a very tall section. As the user scrolls past this initial content block, the age gate and its surrounding elements are removed from view, and subsequent content sections are revealed sequentially with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they become visible in the viewport.
The overall layout emphasizes spaciousness by using large margins and padding around content blocks, creating an airy, uncrowded feel that highlights individual elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (approx. 2.5-3x body) with generous line height, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, giving elements a crisp and defined edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive initial hero section, featuring scattered, overlapping lifestyle images and a central age gate, creates an immersive, art-gallery-like brand introduction. This then gracefully transitions into a spacious, editorial content layout upon scroll, setting a sophisticated tone from the outset.
